aisha_chen: Quick Q — I have an IC moving from ML Engineer II -> Senior ML Engineer, director already signed off. What's the end-to-end process to get title + base pay updated and do we need to route for any additional approvals? Target effective date 2025-04-01. @lina_hr

lina_hr: Congrats! Short version: 1) Fill out the Role Change packet in the HR portal (select 'title + salary change'), 2) attach manager evidence (bullet points and impact examples), 3) route to People Ops for banding check, 4) Payroll needs the final approved form by payroll cutoff for the effective pay period.

samir_khan: To add — if you want no retro pay, submit before payroll cutoff (see @michael_payroll). If you miss it, payroll will calculate backpay from effective date once approved. Also add headcount note if this is a band/level move that changes budget code.

michael_payroll: Payroll cutoff for an effective 2025-04-01 is 2025-03-24 EOD to guarantee no retro. If you submit after 3/24 but before 4/10 we can still process with backpay; after 4/10 it'll roll to next cycle and increase manual effort.

people-ops-bot: Reminder — required fields in Role Change packet: employee name, employee ID, current title, new title, proposed base, effective date, manager justification, director approval, budget code. Attachments accepted: PDF or Google Doc link.

lina_hr: Manager evidence should be 3 bullets max: scope increase, measurable impact (metrics or projects), and example customer/production ownership. If there's a comp panel requirement (for level jumps >1 band) People Ops will flag it and route to Career Framework Review.

samir_khan: Small checklist for you @aisha_chen: 1) Fill portal form, 2) paste the 3-bullet evidence in the "manager rationale" field, 3) attach director approval email, 4) confirm budget code with finance, 5) ping here once submitted.

aisha_chen: Got it — will fill out tonight. One more: how do we handle sign-on/one-time adjustments vs base increases?

lina_hr: Separate flows — base increases go through Role Change packet. One-time credits (spot bonus, retention) use the Compensation Adjustment request and need separate approval from Finance. We'll link the two if both apply so Payroll sees everything at once.

michael_payroll: FYI — if both are submitted together, put a clear note in the payroll comments: "apply one-time payment in payroll period X; adjust base as of 2025-04-01". That helps avoid duplicate payments.

aisha_chen: Perfect, thanks all. I'll submit and ping here when done. :pray:

people-ops-bot: Helpful links: HR portal — https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change, Role Change template — `role_change_template_v2.docx`, Payroll deadlines — https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines.
